description: This file defines fixed-point math macros, constants, and function prototypes for audio effects processing, including logarithmic and exponential functions, gain conversions, and phase calculations, specifically tailored for Android's media effects library.

methods.name: Effects_log2
methods.description: Fixed-point log2 function for unsigned 32-bit integers, returning 15-bit precision.

methods.name: Effects_exp2
methods.description: Fixed-point base-2 exponential function for 15-bit input, returning an unsigned 32-bit integer.

methods.name: Effects_MillibelsToLinear16
methods.description: Converts gain in millibels to a 16-bit linear gain multiplier.

methods.name: Effects_Linear16ToMillibels
methods.description: Converts a linear gain multiplier to millibels.

methods.name: Effects_Sqrt
methods.description: Calculates the square root of a positive number in the range 0 to 2^28.
